description: An oscillator that builds its wave with whole number arithmetic and bit logic, in the manner of a bytebeat, rather than from a waveform

params.text: Sets how many bits of the counter are used, 2 to 16; bits set in X or Y above this count take no part
Sets how far the counter is shifted down in the first X term, 0 to 32
Sets how far the counter is shifted down in the second X term, 0 to 32
Multiplies the counter in the first X term, 0 to 32; above zero the counter is squared, which is where the sound becomes complex
Multiplies the counter in the second X term, 0 to 32
Sets how far the counter is shifted down in the first Y term, 0 to 32
Sets how far the counter is shifted down in the second Y term, 0 to 32
Multiplies the counter in the first Y term, 0 to 32
Multiplies the counter in the second Y term, 0 to 32
Multiplies the whole Y part before it is applied to the X part, 0 to 32
Adds to the whole Y part before it is applied to the X part, 0 to 32
Puts the counter of every voice back to zero, which restarts the pattern
Sets the pitch, -8 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 1Hz to 4186Hz
While on, that bit of the X value is set; the X value is what the rising counter is masked against
While on, that bit of the Y value is set; the Y value is what the second term of the formula is masked against
Shifts the pitch by whole octaves, -8 to 8

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Sets the bits of the X value from a cable, one channel per bit; a channel above 0V sets its bit, and the bits set here are added to those set by the switches
Sets the bits of the Y value from a cable, one channel per bit; a channel above 0V sets its bit, and the bits set here are added to those set by the switches
A trigger here puts the counter of every voice back to zero
Sets XA by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets XB by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets XC by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets XD by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YA by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YB by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YC by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YD by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YM by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets YP by cable, 3.2 steps per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched

notes: the wave is the formula x and t times XC shifted right by XA, or t times XD shifted right by XB, all times YP plus the same shape built from the Y settings times YM
with every X and Y bit on and only XC and YP at one, which is the module's own starting point, the formula gives a saw wave; the factory presets are further starting points
with XC, YM and YC all above zero the counter is squared and the sound turns very complex, which is the heart of the module
going six octaves down turns the wave into a bytebeat pattern rather than a pitch
menu: Oversample — works the wave out sixteen times over per sample and filters it, which cuts the aliasing of the hard bit edges
block DC — takes the constant offset out of the output
